Evan H: FYI — ACME reported that after last night's rollout they see no tool invocations for a subset of prompts. customer pasted examples: 
Customer (pasted): "We call the API with tool_spec and get text only; previously the assistant invoked 'lookupInventory'. Now nothing. request_id=req_8f2b"
Maya R: can you paste the request/response and model+variant they hit?
Evan H: pasted below. model: redwood-2b-instruct, variant: quant-v1, deployment id: dply-2026-03-16-22. request: ```POST /v1/generate
{
  "input": "Check stock for item 9832",
  "tools": [{"name":"lookupInventory","schema":{...}}],
  "temperature":0.0
}```
Evan H: response (what customer saw): ```{
  "id": "...",
  "output": "We have 12 units in stock."
}``` (no tool call envelope)
Samir P: interesting — logs show the request arrived and preprocessing flagged toolcall candidate, but the serving runtime returned plain text at token 1 for that request_id. attaching excerpt from infer logs: ```[22:12:05] req_8f2b: start; [22:12:05] req_8f2b: model-step 1 -> emit TEXT; [22:12:05] req_8f2b: emit TOOL_CALL suppressed:false args_serialized:"{\"item_id\":\"9832\"}"; [22:12:05] req_8f2b: finalizing;```
Maya R: wait the logs say emit TOOL_CALL but customer didn't see the tool envelope. Could be an encoding/escape issue where the tool envelope tokens got merged into text output and filtered by our postprocessor. Did we change any postprocessing in the recent commit?
eng-oncall: I just checked the commit diff for the deployment: there's a small change to the toolcall serializer to strip leading newline when content starts with plain text. Might be the cause. rolling back that change on canary would be quick to validate.
support-bot: Created internal ticket #SUP-4821 and attached customer examples.
Evan H: Can we repro locally? I tried with same model+variant and got the tool envelope correctly when running older image, but with the new image the envelope arrives as a single text token: ```Assistant: We have 12 units in stock.
[tool_call] lookupInventory({"item_id":"9832"})``` — frontend strips bracketed lines by default for our SDK so customer only saw first line.
Maya R: ok so two options: patch postprocessor to preserve bracketed tool envelopes, or revert serializer strip. Which is lower risk?
Samir P: revert serializer on canary now, run a small batch of recorded customer prompts. If that fixes it, rollout a hotfix.
eng-oncall: rolling back serializer change on canary (deploy dply-2026-03-16-22 -> dply-2026-03-16-22-rollback). I'll post results in ~10m.
Evan H: letting ACME know we're investigating; they asked for ETA — i'll say "investigating; possible temporary rollback".
eng-oncall: canary rollback applied, initial tests show tool envelopes now emitted as structured tokens again for sample reqs. confirming against customer's exact examples now.
Maya R: if canary confirms, let's prepare a patch with regression test around serializer and SDK behavior, target hotfix today.
Evan H: thanks — I'll update customer and escalate if they see anything else.
support-bot: SUP-4821 updated: status = canary-rollback-applied.
Evan H: will close thread if ACME confirms resolution.
